provenance: Facility and venue coordinates for the distribution, v2 (record BJ, 2026-11-18). Coverage is now the FULL known universe: all 71 real facilities of the 2026-11-18 census (Tokyo DisneySea 39, Tokyo Disneyland 32) plus 4 venue entries (theaters / performance spaces that host settled shows) — 75 entries in total. Every entry carries kind (facility = the place's own point; venue = the point of the venue where the entry is staged, or the venue itself; representative = the park's entrance-area representative point for parkwide/harbor programs, which have no fixed location — see area-points.json) and a per-entry provenance naming its traceable source. Sources: the original app's facility dictionary (getfacilitydictionary, exported 2026-11-18), cross-checked by the 2026-11-18 full census (§10 Nominatim rule; of the 48 facilities where both the dictionary and the rule held coordinates, 46 matched at 0 m — the 2 exceptions are parkwide entries whose dictionary value is the representative point), plus the record-BJ completion (Nominatim venue and bounded queries, OpenStreetMap features via Overpass, Wikidata coordinates P625 — all queries recorded in the author's verification files). No coordinate in this file comes from AI memory: every point is traceable to a named source. The two entries formerly marked "provenance": "unverified" (センター・オブ・ジ・アース, ダンス・ザ・グローブ！) were corroborated by traceable sources in record BJ and no longer carry the mark; no entry in this file is unverified. Scope: real facilities and their venues only, following the census universe; dictionary rows that are plan-item labels (entry/exit, purchases, rests, meals, movement) and test residue are excluded even when they carry coordinates. Static attributes (record CU, 2026-11-21): each entry may also carry officialUrl and durationMin, taken from the production app's facility dictionary (saved production DB, facilities table) for the row matched by park + name_key; staticSource names that production row (facility id and its static_fetched_at) so every bundled value is traceable to its source row. Coverage over the 75 entries: officialUrl 58, durationMin 28, static attribute group fetched in production 71; the 4 venue entries have no production dictionary row and carry no static values beyond area. Area was already bundled for all 75 entries (record BJ); the production area agrees on 70 of the 71 matched rows — the one disagreement (ジャンボリミッキー！レッツ・ダンス！: production トゥモローランド vs bundled アドベンチャーランド) keeps the bundled record-BJ area, with the production value preserved in the author's record-CU extraction record. Photos are NOT bundled: the production DB stores only an owned-copy blob key (unusable in a copy) and a source kind label, and no displayable photo URL exists in it, so no photo value is carried for any entry; a copy fetches photos at runtime from the bundled officialUrl pages. No bundled value comes from AI memory.

counts.note: sea/land count the census-universe facilities per park; the 4 venue entries (2 per park) are counted separately and are included in total and by_kind.

staticAttributes.note: Counts over the 75 entries. See provenance (record CU paragraph).
